matched_market_comparison.delta_definition: model metric minus market metric; negative favors model

policy.cost_application: deducted once per staked unit on wins and losses
policy.quote_selection: latest valid P32A quote by observed_at_utc within the configured pregame window
policy.roi_denominator: units staked on BET rows only
policy.selection_rule: BET the frozen P50C selected side iff p_selected * selected_decimal_odds - 1 - cost_per_unit >= min_net_ev

quote_source_requirement: P32A TSL_BLOB3RD plus P28AB crosswalk provenance; P39A and generated timestamps are not accepted
